site.name: SEO Facts
site.tagline: An open reference of search engine optimisation statistics.

categories.name: Traffic & Visibility
categories.blurb: How much of the web's attention arrives through organic search, and where it lands.

categories.name: Content & On-Page
categories.blurb: What pages that rank are actually made of: length, structure, media, and intent match.

categories.name: Technical SEO
categories.blurb: The crawl, render, and performance signals that decide whether a page is eligible to rank.

categories.name: Links & Authority
categories.blurb: Referring domains, authority distribution, and the economics of earning links.

categories.name: Local Search
categories.blurb: Proximity, intent, and the business profile signals behind map-pack visibility.

categories.name: ROI & Business Impact
categories.blurb: What organic search returns relative to paid channels, and how teams budget for it.

stats.metric: Organic search share of total website traffic
stats.statement: of all website traffic arrives through organic search.
stats.method: Weighted panel survey; traffic shares self-reported and cross-checked against analytics exports.

stats.metric: Share of clicks going to the first organic result
stats.statement: of all clicks go to the first organic result on Google.
stats.method: Click-stream aggregation across a panel of opted-in browsers.

stats.metric: Average click-through rate for position #1
stats.statement: is the average click-through rate for the first position in Google results.
stats.method: Query-level impression and click logs; excludes zero-click and AI-summary results.

stats.metric: Users who never scroll past page one
stats.statement: of users never scroll past the first page of search results.
stats.method: Session replay and scroll-depth instrumentation on a network of publisher sites.

stats.metric: B2B buyers who research online before purchase
stats.statement: of B2B buyers research online before making a purchase decision.

stats.metric: Searchers clicking the first three organic results
stats.statement: of searchers click on one of the first three organic results.

stats.metric: Searches ending without a click
stats.statement: of Google searches end without a click to any result.
stats.method: Panel browser data; AI summaries counted as zero-click.

stats.metric: Queries triggering an AI summary
stats.statement: of informational queries now trigger an AI-generated summary.
stats.method: Automated SERP capture across desktop and mobile.

stats.metric: Organic visits from mobile devices
stats.statement: of organic visits come from mobile devices.

stats.metric: Organic sessions from branded queries
stats.statement: of organic sessions originate from branded queries.

stats.metric: SERPs containing at least one rich feature
stats.statement: of SERPs contain at least one rich result or feature.

stats.metric: Click share captured by top three results

stats.metric: Desktop vs mobile CTR multiple for position one

stats.metric: Organic visits from returning users

stats.metric: Average word count of a first-page result

stats.metric: Top-ranking pages with contextual internal links
